about: Third sealed set, written 2026-10-10 for open answers (the HUD always answers) and committed before any answer code. None repeats a request from requests.json, sealed-2026-10-10.json or sealed-2026-10-10b.json. `kind`: live (a fact that changes: weather, prices, scores, news, hours), knowledge (stable, the model knows it), local (a query on this Mac answers it), tricky (the two known gaps, a personal question nothing on this Mac holds, and a live word about a local subject). `accept` lists the paths that count as right: weather (Open-Meteo), web (glass search with sources), model (the HUD's model, no tools), panel (bound only to queries in `expect`), ask (a clarifying question for a query in `expect`), needs (one line naming the connection it would take). A reply of the form "I don't have X on this Mac" is a refusal on every row. The author also builds the answer path, so this is held out by commit order, not blind. Do not edit to improve a score; add a new sealed file instead.
